commentary: Market breadth remains severely compromised at 33% under a WEAK deterministic gate, indicating that the index rebound is technical rather than broad-based. Under William O'Neil's CANSLIM and Jesse Livermore's discipline, three out of four equities track the broader market trend; breakout failure rates elevate sharply when tape breadth is negative. Stan Weinstein demands operating strictly in confirmed Stage 2 uptrends above rising averages, while Mark Minervini enforces progressive exposure, asymmetric reward-to-risk, and rapid loss cutting. In this hostile backdrop, capital preservation takes precedence. Traders should demand pristine fundamentals, insist on tight volume-contracting pivots, and avoid chasing extended moves until market breadth decisively confirms an institutional accumulation regime.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AMDIND.technical: Cleared the 20-session high to print a fresh 52-week high backed by a massive 21.8x volume expansion. Price trades comfortably above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, satisfying Minervini Trend Template rules, though the vertical advance shows mild short-term extension.
AMDIND.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales grew 40.4% YoY to ₹122 Cr with PAT surging to ₹9.1 Cr. However, capital efficiency is deficient with ROCE at 1.43% and negative ROE (-2.6%), while interest coverage remains thin, failing CANSLIM institutional-quality tests.
AMDIND.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below the breakout level; honor the scanner stop at 55.95 to protect against false expansion failures.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high to mint fresh 52-week highs on 10.3x volume. Maintains crisp Stage 2 alignment above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, demonstrating top-tier relative strength and Darvas box progression.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Outstanding operational acceleration with Q1 FY27 revenues up 111% YoY to ₹88 Cr and net profit leaping 151% to ₹27.4 Cr. Supported by an impressive 27.1% ROE, 29.6% ROCE, zero net debt, and high-margin patent-protected IP.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Violating the 759.99 stop invalidates the pivot; maintain disciplined risk cut-offs given current weak market breadth.

BODALCHEM.technical: Forming a constructive double bottom base with neckline pressure at 189.87, consolidating a powerful 231% flagpole into a tight 16.8% flag. Momentum is positive with MACD above zero and moving averages in full bullish Stage 2 alignment.
BODALCHEM.fundamental: Turnaround gaining momentum with Q1 FY27 revenues rising 56% to ₹709 Cr and PAT surging 219% to ₹30 Cr on chemical demand recovery. Nonetheless, debt leverage, modest ROE (2%), and interest coverage of 1.6x warrant monitoring.
BODALCHEM.risk: A breakdown beneath the 162.06 base support voids the pattern; exit swiftly if supply overwhelms the flag.

CASHIETF.technical: Cash-equivalent overnight debt instrument holding near ₹1,080 NAV with near-zero price volatility. Completely lacks Stage 2 advancing trend dynamics, momentum, or equity relative strength characteristics.
CASHIETF.fundamental: Liquid rate ETF investing strictly in overnight TREPS and repo instruments. Generates no corporate earnings, revenue, or return ratios; acts solely as a cash management vehicle outside equity CANSLIM parameters.
CASHIETF.risk: Not an equity growth instrument; immediate opportunity cost risk if held for capital appreciation purposes.

CEIGALL.technical: Constructive 23.2% cup pattern featuring a tight 3.3% handle testing 406.11 pivot resistance. Price holds comfortably above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with MACD above zero, indicating healthy supply absorption.
CEIGALL.fundamental: Consistent EPC execution lifted Q1 FY27 revenues by 15.7% to ₹970 Cr and PAT to ₹63.8 Cr (+18.2%), backed by a ₹13,000+ Cr order book and 17.3% ROCE. However, earnings growth decelerated from Q4's 78% pace.
CEIGALL.risk: The setup fails on a breakdown below the 379.81 handle stop; cut losses if infrastructure execution slows.

CPCAP.technical: Tight consolidation trading within 1.5% of its 142.14 pivot on 2.67x volume expansion. Well-anchored above ascending 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, with RSI at 70 exhibiting constructive accumulation without excessive stretch.
CPCAP.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales expanded 16% YoY to ₹22.3 Cr with PAT rising 21% to ₹13.3 Cr on education loan book growth. While operating margins are robust, modest ROE (7.3%) and micro-cap liquidity keep it below top CANSLIM thresholds.
CPCAP.risk: A close below the 126.31 support invalidates the pivot structure; adhere strictly to stop discipline.
